title: scilex-lpwc-ap collection profile
description: Declares one collection (one review) for the scilex-lpwc-ap mapping: its source, its IRI namespace, its dataset metadata and its tag grammar (grid declaration, ORSD UCR3 / D22). Read by scripts/build_iteration.py, by the FnO functions (SCILEX_PROFILE) and by SciLEx (scilex-build-kg). Since iter4 (profile 0.4.0); schemaVersion 1.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the profile is written for. Absent means 1.

slug.description: Short name of the collection: output file name (rdf_data/<slug>.ttl) and, without 'base', the last segment of its namespace.

base.description: Namespace of the collection's resources ({{BASE}}), ending with '/'. Default: https://w3id.org/scilex/data/<slug>/. The FnO functions read it from here (iter4, A3); they no longer rebuild it from the slug.

use_case.description: Use case (UCA-UCD) or 'SciLEx' for a profile generated by SciLEx.

source.description: File name of the BibLaTeX export in raw_data/ ({{SOURCE}}).

survey.description: iter5 (ORSD SR1): file name, in raw_data/, of the collection's survey bundle (survey.json, mappings/survey-bundle.schema.json), {{SURVEY}}. Without it only the bibliography is mapped.

creator.description: IRI of the person who owns the review, preferably an ORCID iD ({{CREATOR}}): dcterms:creator and prov:wasAttributedTo of the dataset.

generator.description: Software that ran the mapping, with its version ({{GENERATOR}}), e.g. 'SciLEx 2.3.0'. Default: 'scilex-lpwc-ap scripts/build_iteration.py'.

config_hash.description: Hash of the configuration in force (e.g. 'sha256:...' of scilex.yml), never its secrets ({{CONFIG_HASH}}; ORSD CFG1, CFG7).

extends.description: Reference profiles merged under this one, by file name stem in mappings/collections/. Default: ['_scilex-defaults']. Use [] for a profile that declares everything itself. What this profile declares wins.

origin.description: Who writes the tags of a dimension (ORSD UCR3, UCR10, KR1): SciLEx itself, SciLEx enrichment (PwC / LPWC / ORKG), the review's manual grid, or the review workflow.

lpwc.description: How the values of a dimension lift into Linked Papers With Code (sparql/04): task -> lpwcp:hasTask, dataset -> lpwcp:usesDataset, model -> lpwcp:hasModel, method -> lpwcp:hasMethod, introducedBy -> lpwcp:introducedBy on the matching concept of the 'target' dataset dimension.

target.description: With lpwc = introducedBy: the dimension whose concepts the paper introduces (e.g. DATASET).

broader.description: iter6 (ORSD UCR20): hierarchy of the dimension's values. Value -> broader values of the same dimension, as written in the tags (e.g. EndToEndRE -> [RelationExtraction]): skos:broader. A narrower value satisfies an implication rule that requires its broader value.

implies.description: iter6 (ORSD UCR20, GCQ61, D38): implication rules of the grid. Value -> values of the same dimension a paper coded with it must also be coded with, or with one of their narrower values (e.g. RelationClassif -> [RelationExtraction]): sxv:implies. Violations are listed by GCQ61.

dimensions.description: DIMENSION names of the 'DIMENSION:value' tags. A plain string is a manual grid dimension with no LPWC lifting.

dimension_patterns.description: Python regular expressions matched in full against the upper-cased dimension (e.g. 'KE_[A-Z_]+').

plain.description: Tags without a dimension, grouped: group -> tags (matched case-insensitively). Other plain tags go to TOPIC.

plain_origins.description: Origin of each plain-tag group. Defaults: WORKFLOW -> workflow, PRESENCE and ACQUISITION -> scilex, other groups -> grid.

valueType.description: iter6 (ORSD UCR4): the values a dimension takes. binary: 0 / 1; closed: the 'list' only; magnitude: orders of magnitude 10^k or integer counts; integer: integer counts; open: any value (default). The placeholders ?, NSP and None are always allowed. Values outside the declaration are typed sxv:OutOfGridValue.

list.description: With type closed: the allowed values, as written in the tags.

other_to.description: With type binary: dimension that receives the values that are not 0 / 1 (e.g. a format written in place of 1); the paper is then also coded 1. ORSD iter6: LINEARIZEDGRAPH_BIN -> LINEARIZATION.
